text:
Anselm Reyes is the new conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra's board announced on 14 March 2025.

**The numbers:** Reyes signed a five-year contract. He was chosen from a shortlist of 31 candidates and takes the podium at the start of the 2025-26 season.

Marguerite Oyelaran, chair of the board, led the selection committee and made the announcement. The board's official press release, issued after a closed-session vote, was read aloud at a press conference at Calder Hall.

The release gave no financial terms for the contract.

**What it means for the sector:** A five-year term gives the Philharmonic a stable runway for programming, fundraising and subscriber planning, all of which depend on knowing who will lead the ensemble. A 31-name shortlist suggests a wide search, and the vote taken in closed session points to a board keen to settle the matter before the new season is marketed.

Ticketing and sponsorship decisions for 2025-26 can now be built around Reyes.
